text: Because this is a German public official and €26 exceeds the €25 threshold, I will decline or hand it to the employing office and keep the receipt in the register.
I will refuse every gift in every situation.
I start from awareness at 10:00 today, notify the authority within 72 hours because there is risk, and notify affected people without undue delay because it is high risk.
I will acknowledge the report within seven days, keep the process confidential, and provide feedback within three months of acknowledgement.
